description: Canonical story arcs for Daily Krishna Stories. Every index entry maps to an arc; arcs are ordered chronologically (order). chronological_order of a story is assigned by sorting (order, internal position).

arcs.name: The prophecy of Kamsa
arcs.summary: Narada and the sages reveal Kamsa's doom; Devaki's children are killed.

arcs.name: Birth of Krishna
arcs.summary: The night birth in Mathura prison; the crossing of the Yamuna.

arcs.name: Krishna reaches Gokul
arcs.summary: The exchange of babies; Krishna and Balarama grow up in Nanda's home.

arcs.name: Early Gokul childhood
arcs.summary: Putana, Trinavarta, the cart, the mortar, naming, and household miracles.

arcs.name: Vrindavan childhood
arcs.summary: Forest life: the demons of Vrindavan, the cowherd boys, the flute, nature miracles.

arcs.name: Kaliya and the Yamuna
arcs.summary: The serpent in the poisoned river; the dance on Kaliya's hoods.

arcs.name: Govardhan and Indra
arcs.summary: Krishna redirects the sacrifice; lifts Govardhan for seven days; Indra submits.

arcs.name: Rasa and the gopis
arcs.summary: The autumn nights; the rasa dance; the gopis' love and Krishna's grace.

arcs.name: Akrura's arrival and departure
arcs.summary: Kamsa's summons; Akrura's journey; the painful parting from Vrindavan.

arcs.name: Mathura and Kamsa
arcs.summary: The wrestling match, Kamsa's death, the liberation of the prisoners.

arcs.name: Jarasandha and the kings
arcs.summary: Kamsa's allies; Jarasandha's sieges; Kalayavana; the flight to Dwaraka.

arcs.name: Dwaraka founded
arcs.summary: The building of the sea city; Krishna as king; the Yadava court.

arcs.name: Rukmini and the marriages
arcs.summary: The brides of Dwaraka: Rukmini, Satyabhama, Jambavati, the 16,100.

arcs.name: Syamantaka jewel
arcs.summary: The jewel's curse: loss, accusation, the bear-king, and Krishna's vindication.

arcs.name: Narakasura and the gods
arcs.summary: The deliverance of the earth's earrings; the 16,000 princesses; Indra's flag.

arcs.name: The Pandavas: friendship
arcs.summary: Meeting the Pandavas, Draupadi's svayamvara, Khandava, the Rajasuya plan.

arcs.name: Rajasuya and Shishupala
arcs.summary: Jarasandha's defeat, the great sacrifice, the slaying of Shishupala.

arcs.name: Draupadi's honour
arcs.summary: The dice game; the disrobing; Krishna's protection of Draupadi.

arcs.name: The peace mission
arcs.summary: Krishna's embassy to Hastinapura; the offer to Duryodhana; the failure of peace.

arcs.name: Kurukshetra war
arcs.summary: The Gita, the vow, the charioteer's role in the great battles.

arcs.name: Post-war Krishna
arcs.summary: After the war: Gandhari's curse, Krishna's visits, the Anugita, the end of the age.

arcs.name: Uddhava and the teachings
arcs.summary: Uddhava's visit; the final instructions; the parables of the Uddhava Gita.

arcs.name: The end of the Yadavas
arcs.summary: The sages' curse, the iron pestle, the destruction at Prabhasa.

arcs.name: Krishna's departure
arcs.summary: The hunter's arrow; the end of the Lord's earthly play; Dwaraka drowned.

arcs.name: Other / frame stories
arcs.summary: Frame narratives, glories of Krishna, teachings without a fixed life-stage.

arcs.name: Dwaraka court and royal life
arcs.summary: Court life, royal episodes, visits, and Dwaraka's minor miracles (Nriga, Paundraka, Sudama, the brahmana's sons).

arcs.name: Pradyumna and Aniruddha
arcs.summary: The adventures of Krishna's sons: Pradyumna's cycles and the Aniruddha-Usha romance with the Bana war.

arcs.name: Balarama's stories
arcs.summary: Balarama-focused episodes: marriages, Vraja visits, the plough's feats, Dvivida, Romaharshana, Samba's rescue.
